verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core model is autonomous background automation. Connectors sync data automatically, handling schema changes and incremental syncs with no pipelines to maintain, at frequencies down to 1-minute syncs. Transformations run automatically after syncs or on a set schedule, with alerts for monitoring, and community users describe the syncing as very reliable, though one reports occasional out-of-sync issues. missing for 10: automations beyond data sync/transform pipelines (e.g., AI- or agent-defined background tasks), detailed documentation of schedule configuration, and broader independent corroboration of unattended operation.
